autoDiscovery.label: Automatically discover {{name}} sessions
autoDiscovery.description: When a workspace opens, list its {{name}} sessions using a lightweight index. The full history is saved locally the first time you open or continue a session. Unopened history requires the original source. Turning this off keeps existing entries and copies. SSH workspace discovery is not available.

discovery.enabledDescription: Automatically find settings and content from other agents and update this list. You choose what to import or enable.

content.skillStale: The Skill package changed. Cancel this confirmation and prepare a new preview before importing.
content.reviewedPackage: Reviewed package: {{count}} files. If the source changes, review it again before importing.
content.skillNameConflict: A Skill with this name already has different content or provenance. Change the import name above and retry; the existing copy will not be overwritten.
content.batchUndoWarning: Remove these {{count}} OpenBitFun copies, including edits made to them. External sources are preserved and can be imported again.
content.title: {{name}} content
content.description: Browse external content and manage availability or imports.
content.externalOnly: External content; no native copy has been created.
content.importedDescription: A copy was imported. Changes to the external source are not synchronized automatically.
content.previewOnly: This content cannot currently be imported. Available source information can be viewed here.
content.unsupportedContext: Import is not supported on this host or in this workspace. Source information remains available.
content.sourceDisabled: Disabled in the external agent. External enablement is independent of import; refresh the import plan for availability.
content.setupRequired: The declaration contains unresolved variables, credential references, or unsupported fields. Complete its setup before importing; nothing has been copied.
content.importUnavailable: The current declaration cannot be imported safely, or its import plan is unavailable. Refresh to check again.
content.validationFailed: The source Skill could not be validated. Nothing was imported.
content.previewFailed: Could not prepare the import preview. Refresh and try again.
content.importSuccess: Imported {{name}}. Its copy is now available in the OpenBitFun management page.
content.stale: The source or destination changed. Review the updated preview and confirm again.
content.copyWarning: This creates an independent OpenBitFun copy. The external agent’s files are not changed, and future changes are not synchronized automatically.
content.mcpTarget: Target: OpenBitFun MCP / {{name}}. The copy starts disabled. OpenBitFun manages activation, login, reconnection and tool permissions; external host policies are not copied.
content.targetExists: A Skill directory with the same name already exists at the target. It will not be overwritten. Choose another scope or resolve the conflict first.
content.hookWarning: Review the exact commands and dependencies below. Imported Hooks run under OpenBitFun’s Hook settings and may execute when their events occur.
content.undoWarning: This removes the OpenBitFun copy, including changes made to it after import. The external agent’s original content is preserved and can be imported again.
content.undoRuntimePending: Removed the configuration for {{name}}, but its runtime has not updated. Check the OpenBitFun MCP manager.
content.undoFailed: Removal did not complete. The copy or configuration may have changed. Refresh, review, and confirm again.
content.undoUnavailable: This Skill’s imported copy could not be identified. Review and remove it in the OpenBitFun Skill manager.
content.batchDescription: Copy {{count}} items; skip {{skipped}} items already imported, unavailable, or requiring individual setup. External sources remain unchanged. Enable imported MCP servers and Hooks in their management pages.
content.batchEmpty: No items are ready for batch import. Check individual statuses; use individual import on older hosts.
content.refreshAfterImportFailed: Import operations finished, but refresh failed. Refresh to verify the results before repeating an operation.
content.targetRepair: A Skill with this folder name exists. Identical legacy copies can acquire source information; different content will not be overwritten.
content.mcpImportedDescription: Saved as native MCP configuration. This page has not confirmed the copy’s connection status. Check, enable and connect it in MCP settings.
content.hookImportedDescription: Saved as a native Hook. Review and enable it on the Hooks page; execution also requires the global Hooks switch.

batchState.failed: Success unconfirmed; refresh to verify before retrying

content.undoEmpty: No imported copies can be removed.
content.renameNotice: The copy will use “{{name}}” as its directory and invocation name. Existing Skills and external source files will remain unchanged.
content.invalidImportName: Enter an unused name with 1–100 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.

directUse.conflict: Choose the matching source in the relevant feature before use. Copy import is not supported on this page.
directUse.blocked: The declaration or policy restricts use; check the relevant feature diagnostics. Copy import is not supported on this page.
directUse.runtimeUnavailable: This host cannot use the content; check the relevant feature environment and diagnostics. The source remains viewable. Copy import is not supported on this page.
directUse.runtimeFailed: The relevant feature reported a load failure; check diagnostics and retry. Copy import is not supported on this page.
directUse.configurationChanged: Review the changed configuration in the relevant feature. Copy import is not supported on this page.
directUse.unknown: The source was discovered, but this host has not confirmed usage status. Copy import is not supported on this page.
